postconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the permutations is between 1 and 10^5.
Each element in permutations a and b is between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: d_i is either 0, a_i, or b_i
postconditions.description: Each element in the description d is either 0, an element of a, or an element of b.

postconditions.expression: There exists at least one permutation c that satisfies all the requirements
postconditions.description: There is at least one valid permutation c for each test case.

postconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^5
postconditions.description: The total length of all permutations does not exceed 5 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: Output the number of possible permutations c modulo 10^9+7
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is the number of valid permutations c, modulo 10^9+7.
